name: Transformer overexcitation measurement interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Relates the transformer voltage and frequency inputs to its selected overexcitation supervision.
description: Relates the transformer voltage and frequency inputs to its selected overexcitation supervision. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Voltage and frequency” at the input and “Volts-per-hertz supervision input” at the output. Allowed duty depends on transformer design.
